description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'ClientSearchV2ApiResource' for handling client search requests in the Apache Fineract project. It implements an API endpoint for searching clients by text, delegating the actual search logic to a delegate service.

classes.name: ClientSearchV2ApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for client search functionalities, exposing an endpoint for searching clients via POST /v2/clients/search

methods.name: searchByText
methods.description: Handles POST requests to search clients by text, accepting a paged request with search criteria, and returns a paginated list of client search data.
